target_customer: Employers, insurers and governments buying mental health benefits for workforces
problem: Workforce mental health care in Asia was hard to access and stigmatized; Intellect offers app based, coaching and clinical care for employees.
business_model: B2B enterprise subscription for employee mental health programs

founders.name: Theodoric Chew
founders.background_notes: Led marketing and growth teams at growth stage startups per the YC page; sources report he co-founded Intellect after his own experience with anxiety and therapy.

founders.name: Anurag Chutani
founders.background_notes: Full stack engineer who led engineering teams per the YC page.

competitors.name: MindFi
competitors.what: Singapore corporate mental health app, also YC backed
competitors.traction_then: Early stage, serving corporates in APAC

competitors.name: Calm and Headspace
competitors.what: Global consumer mental wellness apps also sold to employers
competitors.traction_then: Used by companies globally for years

technical_complexity.rationale: Self care app and provider marketplace; difficulty was clinical operations and localization across languages, not core technology.

defensibility.rationale: Enterprise contracts, multilingual provider network and local clinical care create some stickiness; digital content is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Global apps sold to Asian employers but no source shows them displacing a localized provider; Intellect continued to raise through 2022.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in August 2021 reported Intellect claimed 2.5 million app users and 20 enterprise clients including FoodPanda and Shopback, during a pandemic rise in demand for workplace mental health support.

identity.logo: Logo wordmark; no further description in sources

branding.brand_signature: Annual Mental Health Festival event (promoted on the site)
branding.community_and_virality: Company runs Mental Health Festival and publishes workplace wellbeing reports

brand_strength.rationale: Short real word that is easy to say, but generic; press coverage focuses on the founder story rather than the brand, and the company runs events and reports that build recognition.

outcome_analysis: Intellect raised a chain of rounds from 800K seed to a 10M Series A and a 10M Tiger Global led extension in July 2022, and now claims 4 million lives and 200 staff on the YC page. Demand from employers for mental health benefits after the pandemic and a regional focus helped. No later round, layoff or acquisition was found, so the later funding history is incomplete.
notes: Sources conflict on founding year (YC says 2020, some press says 2019). Preqin dates a Tiger Global round to March 2023 with a $45.3M valuation, which conflicts with the July 2022 announcements and is not recorded. The 2020 seed and January 2022 Series A rest on search result summaries of press, with the Series A on the company's own release URL. Competitor source dates are the year only. Founder education was not found.
